meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Phase 07.1 Media Truth, Disclosure & Context QA

checks: text overlay does not hide critical evidence
Hero.rule: Hero may prioritize emotion, but cannot use a visually similar wrong-location image.

Destination Card.rule: Cards may simplify visible metadata, but provenance remains retrievable.

Place Detail.rule: Primary place imagery cannot be substituted by nearby/similar architecture.

checks: evidence media clearly distinguished from atmosphere media
citations never hidden by immersive treatment
Story Explorer.rule: Immersion cannot blur the boundary between documentary evidence and illustrative atmosphere.

checks: reconstruction never silently acts as Then
Then & Now.rule: Visual alignment is secondary to truth; disclose imperfect matches.

Person.rule: No generic historical portrait may stand in for a person.

checks: event image actually depicts/relates to event
Event.rule: An image of the place after the event cannot be implied to depict the event itself.

Community.rule: Community media must not inherit editorial verification merely by appearing beside verified content.

cross_system.provenance: PASS_WITH_RULE — frontend may simplify display but provenance must remain retrievable where relevant
cross_system.rights: PASS — rights/license required before production publication
cross_system.reconstruction: PASS — explicit disclosure and visual distinction required
cross_system.accessibility: PASS_WITH_RULE — useful alt; evidence captions/provenance available; inspection for records/artifacts

production_rules: A production asset must resolve to the correct MediaAsset and correct entity/content relation before publication.
Hero/card visual convenience never permits wrong-location, wrong-person, lookalike or random substitution.
Evidence-sensitive media must keep provenance/caption retrievable near the viewing context; immersive layouts may not hide evidence identity.
Reconstruction, AI-generated, illustration and material restoration/colorization must be explicitly classified/disclosed where users could mistake them for documentary evidence.
Then & Now must disclose viewpoint/date/spatial mismatch and cannot silently use reconstruction as historical photography.
Event media must distinguish images of the event from later images of the same place, memorial or reenactment.
Artifact/source presentation preserves evidentiary detail and native ratio where needed; card consistency cannot justify destructive cropping.
Community media retains contribution/moderation/rights context and never inherits editorial verification by proximity.
Missing media uses a designed provenance-safe fallback; public/local folder scanning, random imagery and visually similar substitutes are prohibited.
Frontend never invents provenance metadata; missing source/rights/classification is a CMS/editorial data issue, not a UI inference task.

decision.condition: include the ten production rules above in the locked baseline
